title: Register category combobox: Enter on partial text creates a category in the Credit Card Payments group
notes: Pre-existing (identical code). 'New Category' is item 0 and highlighted while typing, so Enter creates a category named after the partial text; InlineAddRow.createCategory uses budget.groups[0], which is the internal Credit Card Payments group. Repro: inline add row, Category 'Comer F' + Enter -> new category 'Comer F' under Credit Card Payments.
